upsertPapers.title: Online Algorithms for Geometric Independent Set

upsertSlices.label: Online independent sets: maximal versus maximum
upsertSlices.task: Feasibility and competitive cardinality have separate panels and units.
assumptions: Maximality uses a zero-recourse axis. Maximum-size competitiveness uses symbolic ζ-dependent ratios. The geometric-independent-set preprint concerns graphs via neighborhood independence; no geometric oracle is assumed.

axis.label: See scoped figure panels; incompatible objectives have separate axes

results.guarantee: Maximal independent set after every prefix
results.notes: Accept a vertex iff it has no accepted neighbor. Rejected vertices retain an accepted witness; later arrivals cannot destroy maximality. This is a derived online consequence, not a competitive maximum-size theorem.
The same greedy output is maximal; this panel measures its size against maximum optimum.
Do not interpret this ratio lower bound as a lower bound on the effort needed to maintain maximality.
The ζ-dependent formulas are categorical anchors, not fixed numerical ratios.
